correctness.rationale: For rank-two PSD A=diag(a,b,0,...), Gaussian sketch q=Ag/||Ag|| leaves a rank-one residual eigenvalue r=ab/(a+b)[1+ab/(a²cos²theta+b²sin²theta)]. An independent Gaussian probe gives centered error r(Z²−1) with Z independent of r, making overestimate probability P(Z²>1) universal. The exact angular integrals E[1/D]=1/(ab), E[1/D²]=(a²+b²)/(2a³b³) give Var(T++)=ab(a²+6ab+b²)/(a+b)², versus 2(a²+b²)/3 for three Hutchinson probes. The difference has palindromic quartic 2t⁴+t³−14t²+t+2 and unique t≥1 threshold 2.331488011135..., with both variance signs. Dominated convergence under A→A0 in fixed dimension gives nearby positive-definite persistence. Independent Sympy rational verification and threshold calculation support, not replace, infinite proof.
